Register Database Backup & Restore

Full app backup (everything inside the app)
Includes classes, students, teachers (with logins), subjects, weeks, terms, sessions, assessments, mid-term, termly scores, comments, quizzes, assignments, feedback, exam inbox and the register. Keep the file private – it contains passwords.
Register-only backup
Restore from a backup file

Accepts: full-app .json, full-app .zip of CSVs, a single table CSV named after the table (e.g. students.csv), or a register .json / .csv. A full-app restore always merges: rows with the same id are updated, nothing is deleted.

 
Browser safety copy
Database setup (run once in Supabase → SQL Editor)

General C.A Record

How it works: Test /10 + Take Home Assignment /10 = 1st C.A /20 · Quiz /5 + Debate /5 + Project /10 = 2nd C.A /20 · Affective /10 (Attendance, Appearance, Honesty, Punctuality, Relationship with Others, 2 each) + Psychomotor /10 (Note Copying /5, Practical/Project /5) = Proj/Ass /20 · Exam /40. When you press Save & Push to Report Card, the record is stored in the database and the totals are sent straight to the termly report card (1st C.A → Test 1, 2nd C.A → Test 2, Psychomotor → Project, Affective → Assignment).
Senior Secondary classes use the same page with their own format: Test 1 /10 + Test 2 /10 + Assignment/Project /10 + Exam /70, pushed to Test 1, Test 2, Assignment/Project and Exam on the report card.
Choose class, subject, term and session to open the record.

Termly Score Entry

Offline scoresheet: choose Class, Subject, Term & Session, then download the Excel scoresheet. It lists every student with the five score columns (Junior classes: Test 1 /20, Test 2 /20, Project /10, Assignment /10, Exam /40. Senior Secondary classes: Test 1 /10, Test 2 /10, Assignment/Project /10, Exam /70). Fill it in offline, then upload it back here to save all scores at once.

Termly Report Cards

Parent Notifications

Save each family's WhatsApp/SMS number and email once. Nigerian numbers can be typed as 0803… ; other countries use +233… style.

One place to send report cards to parents. The app builds each child's report card PDF and prepares one WhatsApp message per parent (short, with the school name and the PDF link), using the phone numbers class teachers entered. You then send them exactly like Send alert: tap WhatsApp next to each parent, or use Open next WhatsApp.

Tick the weeks to send all none

Parent Phone Numbers

Type each parent's WhatsApp / phone number next to the child's name, then press Submit. The numbers go straight into Parent Notifications. You can come back and change any number at any time.

Download Report Cards (ZIP)

Creates one ZIP with every student's individual report card as a PDF. Download the whole term or just a single week, and choose how the folders are arranged. Only report cards that have data are included.

The one-click button puts every report card in one folder inside one ZIP, with no student sub-folders. Each file name says who it is for, e.g. Primary 1 - Ada Obi - Weekly - Week 2.pdf.

Tip: for a whole school, download one class at a time. A large ZIP is built inside your browser and needs time and memory.

Fees & Result Access

Admin only
Block students who owe fees from seeing their results, even after results are published. A blocked student (or parent) logging in sees a “results on hold” message instead of the Weekly Report Card, Mid-Term Report, Termly Results and Progress Tracker. Unblock at any time – it takes effect straight away. Teachers and admins are not affected.

Publish Results to Parents

Parents and students can only see a class's termly report card after you publish it here. Unpublish at any time to hide it again.
Publishing does not override fee holds: students you have blocked under Fees & Result Access still cannot see their results.

Exam CBT Setup

Mark a CBT quiz as Exam and choose its term/session. When a student submits it, the score is converted to /40 (or /70 for Senior Secondary) and written straight to that student's report card Exam field. Weekly quizzes keep feeding the weekly Test score as before.

Termly Results

Termly Broadsheet

All subject totals (/100) for every student in a class for the chosen term, with total, average, grade and class averages. Scores below 50 are shown in red.

Termly Performance Analysis

Grade distribution, subject performance, pass rates, top performers and students needing support for the chosen class and term.

Session Cumulative Sheet

Each subject across all terms of the session with the subject average, term averages, and the session total, average and grade.

Student Progress Tracker

Shows a child's academic growth term by term, session by session and class by class, with a trend chart and subject-by-subject progress. Students and parents only see terms the school has published.

Section Links

Each school section has its own login link that opens straight to that section's Teacher and Student login. The Student Login Links open directly on the Student login only, so you can share them with students and parents. Teachers can only enter the link of a section they are assigned to, and students only the link of their own section. Teacher application links open a public form; submitted forms appear under Teacher Applications in the menu.

Quick Management

My Class Students

Each new student gets the next free registration number automatically (e.g. NGIS/25/2026). A number that belongs to a student can never be given to another student.
#Student NameRegistration No. (Username)Password

Full Backup

One click downloads everything entered in the app (students, teachers, classes, assessments, comments, topics, reports, registers, CBT, e-notes, lesson plans and more) in two formats: a JSON file and a ZIP of CSV files (one CSV per table, opens in Excel).

Upload a Backup (Restore)

Choose a .json backup or the _CSV.zip made by this app. You will see what it contains and pick which tables to restore. Records are added or updated; nothing is deleted.

Keep the files private. The backup contains student and teacher passwords. Uploaded files (assignment files, exam files, daily story photos/videos) live in Supabase Storage and are not included in this data backup.
